name: Maria Elenor Lopez Rios
crime: Charged: TULSA, Okla. – A native and citizen of the Philippines, Maria Elenor Lopez Rios, 45, and a lawful permanent resident of the United States, was charged by Criminal Complaint in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Oklahoma with falsely claiming U.S. citizenship, making false statements in relation to voter registration, submitting a fraudulent voter registration, and unlawfully voting in a federal election. Rios was arrested today pursuant to the complaint. Voter registration records reflect that she voted in the November 2022, federal midterm election in Broken Arrow, Oklahoma.

name: Gregory Allan Porter
crime: Charged: KNOXVILLE, Tenn. – On October 21, 2026, a federal grand jury in Knoxville returned an eleven-count indictment against Gregory Allan Porter, also known as “Tony Wayne Ortiz,” 67, of Sevierville, Tennessee, for two counts of false statement in a passport application, one count of aggravated identity theft, three counts of misuse of a passport, one count of false claim of U.S. citizenship, one count of misuse of a social security number, and three counts of voting by an alien. He was detained pending trial, which has been set for January 5, 2027, in U.S. District Court in Knoxville before the Honorable Katherine A. Crytzer, United States District Judge. The indictment alleges that Porter, a Canadian citizen, entered the United States unlawfully in or around 1984 and thereafter assumed the identity of “Tony Wayne Ortiz,” an American citizen. In addition, Porter voted in numerous state, local, and federal elections under his assumed identity.

name: Christiane Vinette Young
crime: Charged: Fort Myers, Florida – Christiane Vinette Young (75), a Canadian national illegally present in the United States, has been charged by information with three counts of voting by an alien. According to the information, Young voted in three federal elections—the 2024 general election, 2022 general election, and 2022 primary—despite knowing that she was not a citizen of the United States.

name: George Olawunmi Johnson
crime: Charged: TOPEKA, KAN. – A federal grand jury in Topeka returned an indictment charging a Nigerian national with falsely claiming to be a United States citizen to illegally vote in elections. According to court documents, George Olawunmi Johnson, 67, who was residing in Olathe, Kansas, is charged with one count of false claim to United States citizenship, one count of false claim to United States citizenship in order to vote, one count of fraudulent election conduct, and one count of voting by an alien in a federal election.
